resources.string: Answers to questions you asked Hero while offline
Gentle, silent reminders to check your glucose 2 hours after a meal or bolus
It\'s been 2 hours since your meal/bolus. Time to check your glucose reading.
It\'s been 2 hours since %1$s. Time to check your glucose reading.
Shows your most recent glucose reading
Need a few recent glucose readings to project ahead.
On-device estimate from trend, insulin, and carbs. Not a medical device.
Alerts when intense activity overlaps elevated insulin on board
High intensity with insulin on board. Consider %1$d g of fast-acting carbohydrate to help prevent a low.
Guided overnight basal and single-meal carb-ratio checks. Glucose must stay observable, and extra food or correction boluses invalidate the window.
Food was logged during the test window. Start again with no meals.
An extra bolus was logged during the test window. Start again without correction doses.
Food or an extra bolus was logged. The test is no longer valid.
Not enough glucose readings in the window to recommend a change.
These results are informational, not prescriptions. Do not change basal, ICR, or ISF without your care team. GlucoseHero is a logging tool, not a medical device.
If glucose falls below 54 mg/dL and you do not dismiss the prompt, GlucoseHero can text designated caregivers with your glucose trend and GPS coordinates.
SOS texts are sent from this phone via SMS. Grant SMS and location permission for dispatch. This is not a substitute for emergency services. Call 911 if you need immediate help.
Severe hypoglycemia prompts and caregiver dispatch
%1$d mg/dL, %2$s. Tap I\'m OK to cancel caregiver SOS.
Could not send SMS. Check SMS permission and caregiver numbers.
Current reading %1$d mg/dL (%2$s). If you dismiss this, caregivers will not be texted.
If you do not respond, GlucoseHero will text your caregivers with this reading, trend, and location.
Glucose history is encrypted on this device with AES-GCM before upload. The wrapping key stays in Android Keystore and never leaves the phone. Uninstalling the app permanently loses that key.
Choose WebDAV or Google Drive to continue.
Paste a short-lived OAuth access token with the drive.file scope. GlucoseHero does not ship a Google Sign-In client; the token is Keystore-wrapped on this device.
Replace this device from the cloud?
This downloads the latest encrypted blob, decrypts it with the Keystore key on this device, and replaces local data.
Photograph meal for a nutrition estimate
Camera permission needed to photograph your meal.
Fat in this meal may delay carbohydrate absorption and shift the glucose peak later.
Say or type a log, e.g. 40 g oatmeal, 2 eggs, 3.5 u Humalog 15 min ago
Log a meal, insulin, or glucose
Microphone permission needed to dictate a log.
No speech recognizer is installed on this device. Type the log instead.
Filled with the on-device parser. Check the fields, then save.
Could not find a glucose, insulin, meal, or time in that text.
No API key configured. Add one in Settings → Hero AI.
You have reached today\'s Hero AI limit.
Hero AI did not return usable JSON. Try again, or fill the fields by hand.
Your AI provider returned an error. Check the model and API key in Settings → Hero AI.
Could not reach Hero AI. Check your connection and try again.
Could not complete that Hero AI request.
Lower-median 2-hour glucose alternatives, only when two foods each have enough repeats. This is observational, not a claim that a food causes a spike.
Swaps appear after at least two foods each have five two-hour glucose readings, and one typically rises more than the other by 15 mg/dL or more.
When you logged %1$s, median 2-hour change was %2$s (%3$d times). When you logged %4$s, it was %5$s (%6$d times). That is %7$s lower with %4$s.
Carb amounts were not always logged with these meals.
The alternative also has more protein and fat relative to carbs, which can delay carbohydrate absorption.
This queued question is older than 30 minutes, so it was not sent to Hero AI. Glucose can change quickly. Ask again with a current reading if you still need an answer.
%1$s is not a trusted Hero AI host. Confirm this custom endpoint below, or switch back to a built-in provider.
Hero AI requires HTTPS. %1$s is not allowed.

GlucoseHero will send your API key and chat, including glucose context, to:

%1$s

Only continue if you set this address yourself. Built-in providers do not need this step.
